objective: Independent, complete usable Go IDE reproducing GoLand 2026.1.4 as closely as practical; not a rebranded installed GoLand or a UI-only demo.
coverage: Selected feature obligations from product scope and selected shipped declarations; not exhaustive product equivalence.
status_policy: Every row starts unverified for both actual reference behavior and reconstruction. Static declarations are candidate evidence only. Passing narrow tests cannot satisfy broader rows.

requirements.requirement: Launch as an independent product without installed GoLand/PyCharm, commercial Go plugin binaries, or user IDE settings
requirements.probe: Clean isolated profile; inspect runtime classpath and distribution input manifest; create/open Go project

partial_evidence.observation: open Goland standalone app launched with its own bundle ID and loaded both custom plugins; final launch/repeated activation passed in PID19805. Clean-machine/full independence acceptance still open.

Full multiple-build-context migration, all-implementations confirmation (publicly documented; per-implementation selection unverified), semantic cell editors and remaining advanced scopes are open. Commercial reference runtime remains unverified.

requirements.requirement: Benchmark and fuzz workflows support correct arguments, output and persistence
requirements.probe: Run benchmark and short fuzz fixture, stop fuzz safely, navigate corpus failure

partial_evidence.observation: Independent app ran exact BenchmarkEcho/small (3x and allocations), bounded FuzzEcho (100x), generated a true FuzzFailure corpus and opened its console link. Recheck displayed corpus gutter; native context Run and Debug selected one hash, hit the Go callback breakpoint and evaluated its exact value. Infinite Fuzz Stop reaped owned children and showed ignored despite late Go PASS. Native saved settings survived restart. Full scope/framework parity, physical gutter clicking, benchmark Debug and arbitrary manual corpus-name disambiguation remain open.
